'''Corran Antillies This deck is getting worse all the time''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Corran Antillies]]
* '''Published:''' 5 November 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS7]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif|label=This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Sudden Impact (V) (Virtual Set 5)|VS5O-47-Sudden_Impact.png|label=Sudden Impact (V)}}
* '''Strategy:''' This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS7 Deal Antillies DS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Sudden Impact (V), Weather Vane (V) (Dark), Ket Maliss (V), Reegesk (V), Lando Calrissian (V), Bossk (V), Tarkin (V), Hem Dazon (V), Greedo (V), Bane Malar (V), Ability, Ability, Ability (V), Imperial Decree (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

A speed deal that needs help.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Defensive Shields ==

These cards were posted as Defensive Shields outside the deck.

* 1x {{CardLink|Firepower (V) (Virtual Set 6)|VS6O-34-Firepower.png|label=Firepower (V)}}

'Sudden Impact V + 5 (one is firepower v)': five cards under Sudden Impact (V), only Firepower (V) named.

== Notes ==

* Qty 61 as published: Starting 8 and Characters 23 match their headers; Effects, Interrupts and the rest have no counts.
* Weather vane v dested Weather Vane (V) (Dark) (Virtual Set 6); Secret Plans the Special Edition Effect; 'Pt craft' Patrol Craft; 'maul's saber' Maul's Lightsaber; 'epp' characters the With-weapon cards; 'in ship' the pilot-in-ship cards; 'lower corridor' Cloud City: Lower Corridor.
* Original-era (V) slips: Sudden Impact (VS5), Weather Vane (Dark)/Lando/AAA/Imperial Decree (VS6), Ket Maliss/Reegesk/Hem Dazon (VS3), Bossk (VS5), Tarkin/Greedo (VS4), Bane Malar (VS7), Firepower (VS6, shield). Darth Maul x2 as posted.
* Original-era printing corrected: Greedo (V) (Virtual Set 4) -> Greedo (V) (Virtual Set 3); Tarkin (V) (Virtual Set 4) -> Tarkin (V) (Virtual Set 3) (an earlier dest had linked the modern virtual card of the same name).

== Strategy ==

The set up is like a standard speed deal.  get deal out by second turn by pulling folks w/ket malis and sites w/ sorry.  if you can set up a merc pilot at a site or the cc sector, that's an extra bd at all the battles at cc sites (two if both.)  This is just a trick that I think would be cool to pull off.  basically, if you get ambushed at a site in general, ghhk and then ambush next turn.  the three sites are in there for a reason.  One sends people to the weather vane which is where I set up my destroyer droid or whoever.  another is +2 power for the folks w/ a LS.  and the Carbon chamber is in there for all too easy.

The problems I've had,

-Not getting Ghhk in opening hand and getting ambushed at a site when I'm not ready

-having drains cancled

-facing insane space fleets

-Not having access to They must never again leave this city.(I really want to try to get this deck good w/out this card)

I gues that's it, please don't be too harsh

Vader- Thanks for the rating.  Look at the last location on the list.  It says Cloud City.  This is the cloud city sector.  Also, Bane is in there for his other function.  That's why I play Firepower v.

Cam- Thanks for the rating.  I don't think slip sliding away v helps very much, since I can only do it during my move phase.  I'll definately work towards that space package though.  I have looked at that speed deal deck on decktech and I'll probably try to make stuff better there.  Plus, I've playtested this deck.  It definately can't hold its own against any good LS decks.  Lol.
